responsibility: Implements the rs6000 compatibility version of Intel SSE3 intrinsics for powerpc64le. The header maps horizontal add/subtract, addsub, duplicate-move, load-dup, and related SSE3 operations onto VMX/VSX vector permutes, merges, loads, and arithmetic, while deliberately rejecting unsupported monitor/mwait semantics; it is the target-specific inline translation layer that lets SSE3-oriented source build against PowerPC vector facilities.
